text: Before outcomes, protocol tools/scenarios/gls-factor-diagnosis/protocol.json declared and hashed cb6b6ad72cdbbff293662bc48b9f7df66a779f12e99cf15b5246e4e9e92cb1e3 (root 973860617). Diagnostic: full 2 AR orders x 2 nuisance loads x 2 censor policies x 3 pooling strategies, 512 independent innovation blocks paired across 24 cells, known-phi/corrected public fits, variance-scale/covariance-geometry decomposition and paired factor bootstrap intervals. No diagnostic admission. Independently declared confirmation: 2048 fresh datasets/cell for short-run global and run pooling, and doubled-run voxelwise AR(2), all high nuisance/censored, against original margins. Short pooling cells share data deliberately; long cell uses a separate stream. All three confirmations will run regardless of diagnostic outcome, with no altered df or production statistical formula. Seed sets checked disjoint from prior declared data streams. Original short voxelwise adverse result stays binding; any pooled recommendation is restricted to the homogeneous-noise truth examined.
